groups.name: upstream
groups.why: the USB-A PCB plug (host side, declared pose) with the two ESD diodes on its D-/D+ lines, which belong right behind its pins

groups.name: power
groups.why: power entry and switch: JP1 bridges the plug's VBUS to VIN, J9 is the external GND pad beside it, U2 (SLG5NT1487V load switch, D=VIN, S=+5V) with its VIN cap C21, its CAP-pin cap C28, the VIN and +5V TVS D24/D25 and two 22uF output bulk caps at its S pin

groups.name: core
groups.why: the XR22417 hub with its VCC5/VCC33/VCC18 and regulator-output decaps, the VBUS_SENSE divider R1/R2/C2 at pin 41, the EXT_RST#/TEST pull-ups R3-R5, REXT R6 and the 12 MHz crystal (no load caps on this board)

groups.name: ports_east
groups.why: downstream ports 1-4 (JST-SH, declared poses on the east edge) with their D-/D+ ESD pairs, each port's 0.1uF VBUS cap on the front and two 22uF VBUS bulk caps per port on the back

groups.name: ports_west
groups.why: downstream ports 5-7 (JST-SH, declared poses on the west edge) with their ESD pairs, VBUS 0.1uF caps on the front and 22uF bulk caps on the back

groups.name: leds
groups.why: the seven bicolour port-status LEDs (common LED_CTL net /LC) on the front with their 470R series resistors on the back
